scientific_hypothesis: Exact propagation through the diagonal part of the local spectral operator is the missing prior. It should make target data responsible only for the nonseparable mode-conversion correction, producing a stable partial-coverage learning curve.
rival: The coupled correction is still too direction-specific or optimization-sensitive; even with the uncoupled carrier supplied from the PDE, partial target fields do not improve held-out response progressively.

carrier.construction: Set every off-diagonal entry of the known local cosine-Galerkin coefficient matrix to zero, solve the resulting uncoupled two-point boundary problems exactly, and use that response as the fixed prediction before learning.
carrier.interpretation: The carrier captures uncoupled propagation; learning is restricted to the 5.66% mode-conversion residual.

residual_instrument.contract: Exactly linear in the eight boundary coefficients. The previously tested coordinate kernel predicts an additive residual over the fixed carrier.
residual_instrument.initialization: The residual readout is initialized exactly to zero, so the initial prediction is the carrier.
residual_instrument.network: Propagation Fourier features plus one-hot output-mode identity; three hidden SiLU layers of width 128; eight residual kernel coefficients.

protocol.evaluation: Expected relative root-mean-square error of carrier plus learned residual on held-out boundary drives.

registered_gates.capacity: Capacity-control geometric-mean error at most 0.5%, with every seed at most 0.75%.
registered_gates.target_threshold: Eight-field geometric-mean target-only error at most 1.5%.
registered_gates.one_field_not_saturated: One-field geometric-mean target-only error at least 2.5%.
registered_gates.material_improvement: Four-field error at most 80% and eight-field error at most 50% of one-field error.
registered_gates.monotonicity: Geometric-mean target-only error strictly decreases at every budget.

decision_rule: All gates must pass before source transfer is measured. Capacity failure rejects the residual instrument; saturation failure refutes the diagonal-carrier hypothesis as a sufficient measurement prior.
scope: A pass would establish a useful controlled prior on one nonseparable elliptic family, not a final architecture.
The carrier is boundary-aware and equation-derived; it cannot establish that a generic learner would behave similarly.
No source-trained result is run or inspected during this gate.
